title: Example request to Business Insights API

blocks.text: Using the following example, you can get the list of available reports by sending a GET request to the /reports/all endpoint.

blocks.item: In the workspace where you added your collection, go to Collections.
Click the OneAPI folder and then click the Business Insights folder.
Go to the Public API folder and select List Reports. The List Reports request appears on the right-side pane.

blocks.text: A successful response returns a Status: 200 message along with all the available reports in the response body.
